title: How to Video Head Swap with Codex MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Codex MCP and Medux to animate a swapped face image with a driving video to produce a head swap video, including setup, request fields,…
operation: Animate a swapped face image with a driving video to produce a head swap video.
prompt: Animate a swapped face image with a driving video to produce a head swap video.

fields.name: face_image_file_id
fields.purpose: Face reference image file id used for the head swap target.

fields.name: positive_prompt
fields.purpose: Positive prompt text for the animation workflow. Default: 一个角色在说话.

fields.name: edit_prompt
fields.purpose: Edit instruction for preserving the swapped face identity. Default: 人脸保持不变.

fields.name: model_id
fields.purpose: Animate head swap model id. Default: animate-head-swap-default.
